name: diezmossv
description: Cloudflare Worker and admin panel for automated CDE issuance from Wompi donations.

scripts.cf:migrate:staging: node scripts/d1-migration-preflight.mjs --binding DB --env staging && node scripts/run-private-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run build && node scripts/run-private-wrangler.mjs deploy --env staging --keep-vars
scripts.cf:cutover:staging: node scripts/assert-fiscal-cutover.mjs && npm run cf:migrate:staging && npm run cf:deploy:staging
scripts.cf:migrate:prod: node scripts/assert-fiscal-cutover.mjs && node scripts/d1-migration-preflight.mjs --binding DB --env production && node scripts/run-private-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:prod: node scripts/assert-fiscal-cutover.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/run-private-wrangler.mjs deploy --env production --keep-vars
